title: The principle is not falsifiable as a mathematical statement

statements.text: Like the principle of least action, the free energy principle is a general description of things defined in a particular way, not a falsifiable theory about how things behave. It may be falsifiable only insofar as its postulates refer to a class of empirical phenomena.

sources.quote: the FEP is not falsifiable as a mathematical statement, but it may as well be falsifiable to the extent that its postulates refer to a specific class of empirical phenomena that the principle aims to describe.
